prompts.task: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation to the Go key-value store service in ./service. Assume no custom business spans are requested.
Instrument the Go key-value store service in ./service with OpenTelemetry while preserving the existing runtime and startup command. Add auto-instrumentation only; do not add custom business spans.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for resulting files when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Instruments the executable server path under cmd/kvstore-server, not the library package on import.
Preserves the existing kvstore package APIs and avoids moving business logic.
Uses otelhttp.NewHandler for stdlib HTTP routing and keeps span names low-cardinality.
Reads service name and OTLP endpoint from environment or safe defaults.

Bridges the existing standard logger through exactly one official Go logging bridge and one shared-resource batched OTLP LoggerProvider targeting the signal-specific local Splunk Observability Studio /v1/logs endpoint by default.

Exports each fixture request-context warning exactly once with its body, WARN severity, go-kvstore resource identity, and non-empty unique trace and span IDs while preserving the existing standard-log console sink.
Honors OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none and another explicit operator-owned exporter by installing no local LoggerProvider or bridge while leaving the standard-log console sink active.

Resolves the preflight-approved local logs receiver for the selected runtime from signal-specific or compatible generic OTel configuration, receiver status, or checked-in launch/Compose evidence when present; uses the conventional 127.0.0.1:4318/v1/logs fallback only when no such receiver evidence exists. Requires an explicit OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT to equal that approved host, port, and path; a local-looking URL with a different port or path, generic or signal-specific log headers, or log exporter setup failure skips only the added log pipeline, emits a diagnostic without configuration values, and leaves trace/metric startup and the existing logger sink active.

Keeps generic or signal-specific cloud endpoints, headers, credentials, and forwarding out of the application-log path; direct cloud remains trace/metric-only and logs stay local unless explicitly operator-owned.
Uses one shutdown path on every normal or signal-driven server exit so the single log provider and its batch processor flush once.
Updates the existing .vscode/launch.json as required by the skill instructions.
